name: Biodesign Car
region: France, Germany, Japan and the United States
summary: The soft, organic car of the 1990s. A rounded one-box body with an oval face, body-colour bumpers and large clear lamps. The cabin is soft cloth and curved plastic.

philosophy.core_thesis: A car for everyday life has the forms of a plant or an animal. It is round, smooth and friendly, with no hard edge and no sign of a machine.
design_principles: Round each corner with a radius of at least 15 cm, and merge the bumpers into the body.
Paint the bumpers and the door mirrors in the body colour.
Shape the face as an oval or a smile, with large, clear, curved lamps.
Raise the roof into a bubble to give a tall, open cabin.
Cut the number of body panels, and keep the shut lines thin and even.
Shape the dashboard in soft curves, in two-tone plastic, with round vents and a single curved binnacle.
Trim the seats with a bright, soft knit or velour in a playful pattern.
anti_patterns: A long, low wedge with pop-up lamps

silhouette.shape: A compact one-box or two-box body with a high, rounded roof, a short sloped bonnet and a rear that ends in a smooth curve.
silhouette.line: One smooth line from the bonnet over the roof to the tail, with no break at the screen or the lamp.
silhouette.fit: A tall, open cabin with a high seat position and a lot of glass; the body is short but roomy.
silhouette.proportion: Length 3.4 to 4.3 m; height 1.4 to 1.7 m; wheels at the corners; overhangs short.
rules: Round the front in one smooth curve with a small, oval grille.
Set large lamps with clear lenses into the curve of the wings.
Paint the bumpers, the mirrors and the door handles in the body colour.
Use a rear window and a tail panel that flow in a single arc.

fabrics.rule: Use a mass-made steel body with moulded plastic bumpers and trim in the body colour, and soft, bright polyester cloth in the cabin.

methods: body in thin pressed steel with few panels
bumpers moulded in plastic and painted in the body colour
shape tuned in the wind tunnel
surfaces drawn in computer-aided design and checked on a clay model
knit cloth woven or knitted in bright patterns
construction.closures: Flush door handles in the body colour, a wide tailgate, and a remote key.
construction.details: An oval face, a body-colour bumper, large clear lamps, a rounded roof, a curved dash with round vents and a bright knit seat.

surface.pattern: Plain, bright body colour; seat cloth in a bold, soft pattern, often with dots, waves or stripes.
surface.gloss: Metallic paint at 80–90 GU; soft plastic at 5–15 GU; clear lenses are bright.
surface.wear: Plastic scuffs, the paint on the bumper chips, and the cloth pills at the seat edge.

palette.strategy: Friendly, light colours such as pastel green, yellow, blue and silver, with a two-tone cabin in grey and a bright accent.

processes: paint of body and bumpers in one colour
making.scale: Mass-made in the hundreds of thousands, from a small and a medium car platform, with a small range of body colours.
making.signs: Round shapes, an oval face, bumpers painted in the body colour, large clear lamps and a soft, curved cabin.

pieces.form: Small one-box hatchback with an oval face and a bubble roof
Rounded saloon with an oval rear window and body-colour bumpers
Curved two-tone dash with round vents and one binnacle
Soft velour seat in a bright, simple pattern
Soft, round wheel in grey plastic with a big hub

emotion.target_response: A friendly, calm mood. The viewer sees a soft, round car that looks safe and easy to use, with no hard edge.

use_cases: an image prompt for a small rounded car
a design lesson on soft form
avoid_when: the brief wants a sharp, aggressive sports car
the brief wants a luxury or a classic look
the brief wants chrome and bright metal

modifiers.how: Return the chrome, add a round lamp and a painted dash, and echo a 1960s small car.
Remove the grille, flatten the surface and use a plain, quiet cabin with one screen.

ornament_level.note: The form is the ornament: round shapes and one bright colour.
